meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先检查并刷新本技能;然后分析你 fork 的改动,提取你的定制内容,生成一份可重放的迁移指南;升级时在干净的上游代码上按指南重新应用这些定制,而不是直接合并,从而避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求把 NanoClaw 的 fork 升级到上游版本、执行迁移,或让 Claude 分析改动规模时,它会接管整个流程。

say.text: 把我的 NanoClaw fork 迁移到上游最新版
say.note: 触发提取定制并生成指南

say.text: 先分析我改了哪些文件,再生成迁移指南
say.note: 它会用子代理扫描改动

say.text: 用现有指南直接升级,保留我的定制
say.note: 如果指南已存在,会跳到升级阶段

howto.what_en: On enable, Claude refreshes the skill, extracts your customizations into a replayable migration guide, then upgrades by reapplying them on clean upstream instead of merging.
howto.when_en: When you ask to migrate your NanoClaw fork to upstream, upgrade, or reapply customizations, it takes over.

say_en.text: Migrate my NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream.
Analyze my changes and write a migration guide.
Use the existing guide to upgrade and keep my customizations.
say_en.note: Skips to upgrade if guide exists.
